fields.statement: ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql.csproj declares each of its NuGet identity and licensing properties (Title, Copyright, Description, PackageIcon, PackageLicenseExpression) and each of its symbol-package build properties (GeneratePackageOnBuild, IncludeSymbols, SymbolPackageFormat) exactly once, as an unconditioned literal value; no PropertyGroup in the file redeclares, conditions, or overrides any of these eight properties.
